meta.disclaimer: Not legal advice. This is a plain-English summary of each state's rules of professional conduct, kept for marketing planning, and rules change. Check the rule text, your state bar's ethics opinions and your own counsel before you agree a fee split or pay for a referral.
meta.notice: Probative is a marketing firm, not a law firm; not legal advice.

changes.title: Method correction
changes.summary: Records are published only where the text was read without passing a human-verification (CAPTCHA) page; the 1.0.0 records for two states that did not meet this were removed from this release. No other record changed.
